task_description: Questions related to bicycles product details

seed_examples.question: What is the "YETI SB140 29" LR C2 GX" type of bike?
seed_examples.answer:
When you need more than just a trail bike to conquer the terrain, you'll want to reach for an all-mountain bike.
All-mountain bikes have longer travel than a trail bike and are able to descend much easier while
still being able to climb.
The Yeti SB140 29" LR C2 GX Bike is built to handle trails that are untamed and unrelenting.
The frame uses C-Series carbon fiber and has 140mm of travel on the rear and 160mm of travel on the front.
The frame features a threaded bottom bracket, high-clearance downtube, dual-density downtube protection,
fully enclosed internal cable routing, long dropper post compatibility, and Boost spacing.

seed_examples.question: What is the "Santa Cruz Nomad 6 CS" type of bike?
seed_examples.answer:
For riders who hunt for the biggest terrain, the Santa Cruz Nomad 6 is the single-crown king.
The MX-wheeled, long-travel Nomad 6 makes the most challenging descents attainable.
Using Santa Cruz's durable C-level carbon, the Nomad 6 C is built to last, with much of
the performance found on Santa Cruz's top-end CC frames.
The Nomad features 170mm of VPP™ rear travel, tuned to increase sensitivity and
improve traction with increased anti-squat,
and is built around a 170mm single-crown fork to tackle the biggest terrain.
With size-specific carbon optimization and proportional geometry,
every Nomad frame is designed for that individual size,
improving the quality of the ride for every rider.

seed_examples.question: What is the "Cannondale CAAD13 Disc 105" type of bike?
seed_examples.answer:
Carbon frames don't get to have all the fun in a race. You can always get an
ultra-lightweight aluminum frame to dominate the criteriums.
The Cannondale CAAD13 Disc 105 Bike is the speediest, smoothest,
best handling, and finest performing aluminum race bike on the planet.
The SmartForm C1 Premium Alloy is the lightest,
most sophisticated aluminum construction available.
The frame has highly truncated airfoil tube shapes that offer the same weight,
and equal or better stiffness, than round tubes, but can reduce drag by up to 30%.
A full carbon fork up front comes with a 12x100 Speed Release thru-axle and internal cable routing.
The frame features internal cable routing, clearance for up to 30mm tires, and stealth fender mounts.

seed_examples.question: What do you know about the "Specialized Vado 3.0 IGH" bike?
seed_examples.answer:
Whether you're commuting to work by bike, going out for a quick spin, or you're riding
to get some morning coffee, you'll want a comfortable bike that you can cruise on.
E-bikes are a great way to remove many of the barriers that keep people from experiencing the joys of riding.
The Specialized Vado 3.0 IGH Bike is the vehicle for everything from daily
commutes to fast workouts to longer-than-planned adventures.
The Vado comes with an E5 aluminum frame and an SR Suntour MobieA32 fork with 80mm of travel.
The frame features a bottom bracket motor mount, a fully integrated and lockable
downtube battery, internal cable routing, and a rear rack.
It also features a Lezyne Ebike Mini STVZO E65 210 Lumen light front light,
a Spanninga Commuter Glow XE 12V rear light, and a simple bell.

seed_examples.question: What can you tell me about the "Marin Fairfax E E-Bike"?
seed_examples.answer:
Whether you're commuting to work by bike, riding your local bike paths, or just going out for
a ride with some friends to your local coffee shop, you'll love riding an e-bike.
E-bikes are designed to give riders an extra boost of power so they can conquer those
steeper hills and longer rides. With Marin Fairfax E E-Bike brings the power to scoot you along
with 40Nm of torque from the rear hub, quietly and seamlessly adding a boost to your pedaling.
It has a Series 2 Fitness 6061 aluminum frame and 6061 aluminum fork.
The frame features internal cable routing, an integrated kickstand, fender and rack
mounts, and two water bottle cage mounts.
The Bafang 250W rear hub motor provides up to 20 MPH of boost
and the internal 340Wh battery will keep you going for many miles.
